name: codex-tps-plus
description: Show non-reasoning end-to-end throughput and delayed TTFT, with an opt-in native OTel TBT reference.

interface.shortDescription: Accurate end-to-end output throughput and delayed TTFT for Codex CLI.
interface.longDescription: Shows non-reasoning output divided by end-to-end turn duration, plus delayed turn TTFT, after Codex CLI responses. Transcript-inferred request intervals remain diagnostic only. An explicit localhost OTel experiment can add a native TBT-derived reference, but unjoinable telemetry is never labeled as current-turn TPS.
defaultPrompt: Show the latest Codex non-reasoning end-to-end throughput and session average.
Show the latest backfilled TTFT and explain its delayed timing.
